user.title: Connect to Control Room
user.description: Connect this Home Assistant instance to the central Control Room broker using secure MQTT over WebSocket (WSS). Enter the host only, without `wss://`.

data_description.site_id: Unique technical identifier for this installation, for example site_001. Lowercase letters, numbers, underscores and hyphens are allowed.
data_description.username: MQTT user dedicated to this site.

error.invalid_auth: The broker rejected the username or password.
